# **Simulated Market Research at Scale: An AI Consultant-Training Simulation and Emerging-Industry Insights Dashboard for TBFI**

## Assignment Purpose

The purpose of this assignment is to develop a Construct and Measurement Table that identifies the constructs used in our research project, defines each construct, explains how each construct will be measured, identifies the scale type, and shows the relationship between the constructs and the research objectives.

## Research Objectives

### AO1

Synthesize published evidence on LLM-simulated survey respondents and assemble a clean secondary data set describing customers and businesses in the four SGV industries.

### AO2

Create perceptual maps and customer segments for the four industries.

### AO3

Assess the validity of large language model panels by comparing their responses against the human benchmark.

### AO4

Evaluate changes in consultant performance before and after completing the TBFI Do Tank Simulator using standardized skill-checkpoint scores.

### AO5

Identify which digital marketing channels generate the highest rates of qualified sponsor inquiries and sponsor acquisitions throughout the marketing funnel.

## Summary

Our Construct and Measurement Table connects the five analytics objectives to the measures needed for the TBFI project. AO1 covers published evidence and secondary customer and business data. AO2 measures brand perceptions and customer preferences to create perceptual maps and customer segments. AO3 compares AI-generated responses with the human benchmark to assess validity. AO4 measures changes in consultant performance before and after the simulator. AO5 tracks qualified sponsor inquiries and acquisitions across digital marketing channels. Together, the table identifies how each concept will be measured, its source, scale type, and role in analysis, providing a consistent blueprint for data collection and evaluation.

## Evidence

The shared Construct and Measurement Table has been completed collaboratively and stored in the group's shared Google Drive folder.

## Proposed Revised POs and AOs (not yet approved by Dr Lin)

We propose reorganizing the project around two domains: (1) Synthetic Respondents & Perceptual Mapping and (2) LLM-Based Text Classification. Findings from both will become best practices and training resources for TBFI, with funnel analytics tracking promotion and business intake.

**PO1: AI-Powered Marketing Research Validation.** Develop and validate AI research methods that give TBFI and SGV businesses reliable consumer insights.

**PO2: Consultant Training & Decision Support.** Turn validated AI research methods into an evidence-based training and decision-support system for TBFI consultants.

**PO3: Promotion & Business Intake.** Run a data-informed digital marketing strategy to grow awareness and qualified business intake among SGV businesses.

**AO1: Synthetic Respondent Validity** (Domain 1, supports PO1). Evaluate how well AI respondent panels reproduce human responses by comparing rank order and level differences against human benchmark data.
